stemMd: In a right triangle, an acute angle has sine 3/5. What is its cosine?
explanationMd: Use sine squared plus cosine squared=1. Cosine squared=1−9/25=16/25. The angle is acute, so take the positive root, 4/5.

distractorRationale.c: This assumes equal sine and cosine without justification.
distractorRationale.a: This subtracts the numerator from the denominator twice.
distractorRationale.e: A cosine of an acute angle cannot exceed 1.
distractorRationale.b: This subtracts linearly instead of using squared lengths.
